question: For the same qualifying XAU/USD setup and frozen canonical anchor, how often is each forward extension reached before structural stop, strategy invalidation or the applicable observation deadline, and what are the simulated net outcomes?

comparison.primary_common_cohort: Only cases where all three targets lie forward of the observation/eligible simulated entry on the profitable side; excluded cases remain in the screening ledger.
comparison.no_fib_baseline: Unchanged canonical Gold target builder, where it produces a valid setup; no invented target when it does not.
comparison.secondary_exploratory: Existing 1.272/1.414 and other hierarchy layers, reported separately with multiple-comparison disclosure.
comparison.inference_warning: Nearer targets naturally have greater touch probabilities. Higher hit rate alone does not establish the better strategy or an optimal cutoff. Extension ratios are swing geometry, not R multiples.

data_requirements.source: Exact intended MT5 broker XAU/USD executable instrument, with broker/server identity retained privately.
data_requirements.quotes: Timestamped historical Bid and Ask ticks, tick flags, export errors and gap/coverage ledger. Native broker bars and documented timestamp/finalization semantics are required.
data_requirements.sessions: Authoritative broker trading intervals, maintenance, holidays and historical DST/UTC offset eras, validated against Gold session manifest rules.
data_requirements.specifications: Point, tick size, permitted volume/contract specifications and historical commission/swap where net monetary performance is reported.
data_requirements.initial_ingestion_pilot: First 20 complete available broker sessions; engineering validation only, not a performance sample-size guarantee.
data_requirements.historical_study_goal: 6-12 months if broker coverage permits; actual dates and shortages recorded before evaluating outcomes.
data_requirements.alternative_feed_policy: FXCM/other spot data may support a separately labelled feed sensitivity study; GC futures cannot stand in for executable XAU/USD prices.

admission_and_chronology.gate_policy: Preserve every canonical Gold structure, causal sweep/displacement/retest, confirmation, freshness, session, risk and evidence requirement. Record rejected and unavailable cases.
admission_and_chronology.point_in_time: Only finalized candles and evidence available at each historical assessment time; pivot confirmation time must precede use. Replay the frozen engine without peeking at future bars.
admission_and_chronology.snapshot: Record decision, anchor prices/times, direction, entry zone, structural stop, normal targets, expiry, invalidation and all required provenance before reading future ticks.
admission_and_chronology.missing_evidence: Unavailable/ineligible, never a qualified observation. If complete canonical admission cannot be reproduced, downgrade the run to an anchor-only study and do not claim qualified-setup probabilities.
admission_and_chronology.overlap: One observation per unique setup/anchor episode for the primary analysis. Retain chronological dependencies; do not count each scan as an independent trade.

outcome_contract.price_observation: Observed Bid/Ask remain separate from approved entry zone. No quote is moved into a zone.
outcome_contract.two_populations: Report pre-entry setup observations separately from eligible simulated entries. No actual Telegram approval or broker order is generated.
outcome_contract.pre_entry_expiry: Use the original setup valid-until deadline. No simulated order can enter after expiry/invalidation.
outcome_contract.post_entry_horizon: Setup/order expiry is not an automatic exit for an already filled trade. Preserve canonical management/invalidation; any extra research follow-up cap must be preregistered before outcomes and results at that cap reported separately.
outcome_contract.entry_model: First later eligible executable quote, or the correct limit/stop fill model inside the original zone; preserve entry eligibility. Approval latency is an explicitly labelled simulation assumption, not a real approval.
outcome_contract.quote_side: Long entries use Ask and long exits/target/stop touches use Bid; short entries use Bid and short exits/target/stop touches use Ask.
outcome_contract.ordering: Use tick chronology. OHLC-only target/stop ordering is indeterminate if both occur in a bar; do not assume target first.
outcome_contract.costs: Observed spread, documented commission/swap where applicable, and preregistered slippage sensitivity. Unknown costs prevent net monetary claims.
outcome_contract.virtual_exits: Fixed single-target research variants are counterfactuals. Preserve SL/entry/gates and label separately from the canonical multi-TP baseline. Do not imply they reproduce existing position management.

outputs: net expectancy in actual entry-to-stop R units
statistics.uncertainty: 95% confidence intervals; day/episode-block bootstrap for correlated observations; effective sample size and raw counts disclosed. No invented confidence when cases are too few.
statistics.data_split: Chronological development/validation/untouched test periods locked before outcome inspection; no random time-series shuffle.
statistics.regimes: Predeclared long/short, broker session and volatility groups; discovery-only subgroups labelled exploratory.
statistics.precision: Choose sample requirement from observed eligible-event rate and desired uncertainty before confirmatory testing. Calendar duration alone is insufficient.
statistics.claim_boundary: No optimal-cutoff, profitability or calibrated-probability claim until the untouched test and independent forward sample support it.

phases: Validate export identity, broker sessions, tick/bar coverage and timestamp semantics.
Build isolated engine replay runner and causal/quote-side/expiry/duplicate regression tests.
Run ingestion pilot; report counts and gaps without strategy-performance claims.
Lock the statistical analysis plan and chronological periods; execute historical comparison.
Collect a later forward shadow sample after collector readiness, without trade proposals or orders.
Review comparative evidence before any separately authorized production change.
blockers: Verified historical broker candles and Bid/Ask ticks not yet supplied or inspected.
Authoritative historical broker session/timezone mapping not yet supplied or inspected.
Gold-specific causal replay/comparison runner is not implemented by this preparation step.
Existing documented Gold route is shadow-only and lacks full live certification; research preparation does not activate it.
